## Audit Complete

**Finding:**
```
machtzev/generator/apps/peruk17.json:82 · field type wrong: "ימים לתגובה" marked as [מספר] particle must have "type":"num" not "type":"text" · P1 task not done · change "type": "text" to "type": "num" on line 82
```

**Coverage:** read peruk17.txt spec line 17 (particle definition with [מספר]); verified police report shows num_particle ❌ 0×; examined peruk17.json lines 80–85 showing field added with wrong type; checked particle-plan-peruk17.json showing correct shape:"number" inferred; confirmed gen_app_peruk17_ent1_content.dart has label c19="ימים לתגובה" and default c20="30"; verified gen_app_peruk17_ent1.dart renders field as DsField (text control) instead of numeric control at line 146; cross-checked available field types in apps/*.json schema (text/multiline/num/date/bool). **Missing:** did not run generator to verify corrected field renders as numeric widget; did not verify the particle hero atom (KpiTile) wires correctly with numeric data.

---

The task is not complete. The spec requires a `[מספר]` (number) particle, but the implementation added the field with `"type": "text"` instead of `"type": "num"`. This causes the generated Dart to render it as a text field (DsField) rather than a numeric control, and the police check `num_particle` failed accordingly.
